'''''Centradenia inaequilateralis''''' is a species of flowering plant in the family [[Melastomataceae]], native to southern Mexico, and Central America.<ref name="567186-1" >{{cite web |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:567186-1 |title=''Centradenia inaequilateralis'' G.Don |author=<!--Not stated--> |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=6 April 2021 }}</ref> With its pink-purple flowers, its cultivar 'Cascade' has gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].<ref>{{cite web |title=''Centradenia inaequilateralis'' 'Cascade' |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/54495/Centradenia-inaequilateralis-Cascade/Details |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |access-date=6 April 2021 }}</ref>
